versions.content: If TcpIp_IsConnectionReady() is called and a security association is configured, the module shall:  check if socket exists and is bound to an assigned local address.  check if the provided remote address has a corresponding physical address.  check if a security association is established for this socket. If all checks are successful, the function shall return TCPIP_E_OK.
